title: Thai Curry Noodles
ingredients: optional other vegetables – pea pods, cauliflower, etc
instructions: Cut up the meat and fry with some soy sauce until browned.
Tenderize vegetables by blanching or steaming meanwhile.
Make coconut mix by mixing coconut cream/milk with turmeric and sugar.
Set cooked meat aside and in the same pan fry up some veggies with soy sauce + fish sauce + oyster sauce. Set aside.
In the same pan fry the chopped up onion until translucent, and then add garlic. Stir for 30s, add red curry paste. After few seconds add coconut mix.
Cook for a few minutes, thicken if needed, then combine everything together.
